businessObjectName.description: ?: Internal representation of the business object, e.g. used by attachments Postgres tables

predefinedQueries.description: ?: set of possible queries, overriding and/or complementing automatic ones  built from provided columns/fields

type.description: M: Attention! Only one main query allowed at most for each kinf of operation

navigationTarget.description: ?: (table view only) target table form to retrieve when a record is selected (if not specified, defaults to self)

hideActions.description: ?: set of actions (by means of related icons) to hide - by default they are shown

tableActionType.description: ?: action affected (& field mandatory) when viewType='table'

formActionType.description: ?: action affected (& field mandatory) when viewType='form'

messages.description: ?: set of messages (by means of related icons) to show

tableMessageType.description: ?: action affected (& field mandatory) when viewType='table'

formMessageType.description: ?: action affected (& field mandatory) when viewType='form'

outputEvent.description: ?: (form/formtable view only) global event triggered on eventType

inputEvents.description: ?: (form/formtable view only) input events associated with the table

eventName.description: M: event name to listen to

actionType.description: M: triggered action, if 'navigate' also set actionTarget below

actionTarget.description: ?: target info, mandatory in case of 'navigate'

type.description: M: view type of navigation target

keymap.description: ?: set of source to target view key mappings, defaults to source primary keys

formRowProperties.description: ?: dinamic handling of attributes in form and form table views

value.description: ?: array of boolean values, one for each table row. One value in case of form view, multiple if table form or table views

queryString.description: ?: query on DB, must return a boolean value NAMED AS 'label' for each row

inputEvents.description: ?: input events associated with the attribute

actionType.description: M: action triggered, showRow means that the row is shown if condition is verified on all keys

keys.description: M: set of keys to compare

items.description: M: set of sender and receiver values to compare with

receiver.description: M: receiver key to compare with

exportQueries.description: ?: List of queries for advanced export

tableQueries.description: ?: List of queries for advanced export

label.description: M: Label for the advanced query

queryString.description: M: Query for the advanced query

formQueries.description: ?: List of queries for advanced export

label.description: M: Label for the advanced query

queryString.description: M: Query for the advanced query

defaultBehavior.description: ?: Default behavior for params not described

table_keys.description: ?: array of view fields to retrieve/display in table view

queryFunct.description: ?: postgresql query format for the column, can be a function or a full query. $field$ means that field is replaced by actual value

style.description: ?: Array of styles for each value

value.description: M: as per specification @ https://www.w3schools.com/cssref/css_colors.asp - defaults to 'transparent'

font_color.description: ?: as per specification @ https://www.w3schools.com/cssref/css_colors.asp - defaults to black

search_keys.description: ?: array of fields of the search form

fieldName.description: M: form field name, might or not correspond to a postgres column

newLine.description: ?: new line with the next field

size.description: ?: size in 1/10 of available space, only considered if sharing line with other keys. If not defined take all space left by the other keys

queryCond.description: M: postgres query condition (after WHERE clause)

subTables.description: ?: one entry for each subTable tab of the single form (record) view

entryKey.description: M: DynamoDB primary key (entry) of subtable

isHidden.description: ?: if not defined defaults to false

keys.description: M: set of key couples that put in relation the record view (parent) with subtable (son)

parent.description: M: parent table key, condition on subtable is WHERE son_key = parent_key_value

inputEvents.description: ?: input events associated with the tab

eventName.description: M: event name to listen to

actionType.description: M: triggered action, based on boolean received value

condition.description: M: condition on received value, only equalTo implemented so far

values.description: M: set of values to compare with, condition must be verified for all of them but '*' jolly values

formKeysFormat.description: ?: array of view fields to show into single/multiple records form view

autoGenerate.description: ?: only if primary key, generated by backend for new entry-> typically table ID

newLine.description: ?: new line with the next field

size.description: ?: size in 1/10 of available space. If defined, must be defined for all keys on the same line. If not defined, space is split equally

style.description: ?: set of form cell style attributes

font_color.description: ?: as per specification @ https://www.w3schools.com/cssref/css_colors.asp - defaults to black

isPrimary.description: M: all primary keys must be always provided with the table query

key.description: M: postgresql table column name, unless it is composed by sub keys (below)

subKeys.description: ?: possible multiple keys concurring to combobox ID field, representing the postgresql table column names)

buttonIcon.description: ?: only considered if button, icon associated with the button

confirmButtonAction.description: ?: only considered if button, ask for confirmation before performing click action

isDownloadButton.description: ?: only considered if button, if true queryFunct must be set returning file_id^filename value and icon is predetermined.

sameOrigin.description: ?: when false indicates the key is not part of table columns, so it is not retrieved by automatic query. Default is true. Not to use together w/ queryFunct (below)

saveWhenHidden.description: ?: when true indicates that the field is not taken in account if hidden while saving the form. Default is false.

queryFunct.description: ?: postgresql query for getting the key value, exclude the field from automatic query. Must NOT be used together with sameOrigin.

insertUpdateFunct.description: ?: postgresql query for inserting/updating the key value, used within automatic query. FIELD MUST HAVE SAME ORIGIN.

evalFunct.description: ?: javascript expression to evaluate the value of the field, typically with £ contoured local parameters. Can or cannot have same origin.

attributeFuncts.description: ?: list of postgresql queries to set various key properties

queryString.description: M: query string, must return a value NAMED AS 'label' of type coherent with the attribute (e.g. boolean for isHidden)

styleAttribute.description: ?: type of style attribute, mandatory and only applicable if 'attributeType' = 'style'

eventName.description: M: event name pushed to other fields, must be unique

eventTrigger.description: M: event trigger type, [change,blur,focus] for input field, press for button and select for [combobox,radiobutton]

conditionalQuery.description: ?: event is triggered only if specified query on DB returns a value different from null, false or empty string

inputEvents.description: ?: input events associated with the field

actionType.description: M: action triggered, also specify styleAttribute if *_style and/or queryFunct if query* and/or updateFunct if update*

condition.description: M: condition on received value, only equalTo implemented so far

values.description: M: set of values to compare with, condition must be verified for all of them but '*' jolly values. '£' contoured local variables also possible.  Unused (empty) if condition = 'none'

message.description: ?: message to pop-up when actionType = show_message

actionOnYes.description: M: action to perform when the user presses Yes

actionType.description: M: type of action to perform

queryFunct.description: ?: query to perform if actionType = query

actionOnNo.description: M: action to perform when the user presses Yes

actionType.description: M: type of action to perform

queryFunct.description: ?: query to perform if actionType = query

styleAttribute.description: ?: style attibute affected, mandatory if actionType = *_style

updateFunct.description: ?: expression to evaluate the value in case of actionType = update* event, typically with £ contoured local parameters

queryFunct.description: ?: query to perform in case of actionType = query* event. If query_style then the returned key must have name key_styleAttribute

outputEventWhenComplete.description: ?: output event name triggered when current event is complete

viewType.description: M: form view type, if 'input' also set dataType below, if combobox or radiobutton also set (also empty) options below

options.description: ?: only usable (mandatory at least empty) in case of combobox or radiobutton

comboQuery.description: ?: combobox/radiobutton query, must return an array of [{“id”: Number, “name”: String}], can contain both passed $key$ and local £key£

validations.description: ?: only for “input” viewType, check on entered data

message.description: M: message to display if condition not met

validator.description: M: e.g. Validators.min, Validators.max, Validators.minLength, Validators.maxLength, Validators.required or (pattern) ^[a-zA-Z0-9&_ ]+$

value.description: ?: Value in case of Min, Max, MinLength and MaxLength validators
